verdict.rationale: Autumn's own CLI can pull dashboard-defined plans and features into a local `autumn.config.ts` file, so pricing configuration can be exported as code. The product is also open-source and runs locally, which eases leaving. However, nothing documents a bulk export of all customer, usage, balance or log data in open formats. missing for 10: documented full-data export (customers, subscriptions, usage, logs), open/standard export formats like CSV/JSON dumps, an offboarding or migration-out guide, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: If you already have products created in the dashboard, run `atmn pull` to pull them into your local config.
pull what's in Autumn with `atmn pull`
Run Autumn: bun dev. That's it! You should be able to see the Autumn dashboard on `http://localhost:3000`.
